# Test fixtures

Short clips used by the tests. Each fixture is cut from a raw Walksnail Avatar recording that is not part of
this repository. Full recordings never go into the repository.

| File | Source | Content | Changes made |
|------|--------|---------|--------------|
| `clip-3s.mp4` | Raw goggle recording, first 3 seconds | 1280x720, H.264, 60 fps, 180 frames, no sound | Stream copy (`-c copy`), sound and subtitle tracks removed. No OSD is burned into the picture |

The OSD and SRT files that go with the clips are added in phase P2 and P3, after their GPS coordinates are
replaced (see PLAN.md, section 10.4).
